Pinching each leading 2x2 block and positive-depth chain gives the stated bound. Exact integer checker establishes S=5606050, H=4330856, strict square-root floors 12088490 and 1769632, and positive rational surplus 7053468/1625. Induced-graph inclusion extends n=13 to every n>=13.

value.rationale: Productivity of crown cores is an explicitly motivated open certificate problem in the primary paper. Establishing the first available exact certificate at core order 13, below the prior n>=15 bound, strengthens a natural integer cutoff and generates a previously unproved infinite core family. The proof is a self-contained finite integer witness applied to a published analytic criterion; the cutoff gain is structurally meaningful rather than a nominal bound improvement.
